title: MICROBIAL LAB TECHNIQUES IN FOOD INDUSTRY
description: Emphasizes the role of microorganisms associated with food safety and quality. Includes practical hands-on experiments for the detection and identification of food quality and safety-related microorganisms. Covers microbial tests currently used in the food industry.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: FST 360 and (MB 302* or 302H*).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D is required in FST 360, MB 302 and MB 302H.
